title: Healthy Volunteers Faked One Symptom, Yet Hospital Wards Could Not Tell
description:
You think hospital doctors quickly spot a healthy person! Yet healthy volunteers got locked inside real wards after intake! This is the true story of Stanford student Bill Underwood. Here is what went wrong across twelve mental hospitals.
